candidates.explanation: The email-change verification URL is built with the '/confirm-email' path, the same one userSignUp uses for sign-up activation. The new-email link therefore opens the sign-up confirmation page. That page calls POST auth/email/confirm (confirmEmail) instead of POST auth/email/confirm/new (confirmNewEmail), so the email change is never completed. The URL should point to a dedicated '/confirm-new-email' frontend route.

fix.description: In confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email' so the frontend page calls the email/confirm/new endpoint.
